page.layout: One block of running text across the full width at the top; below it, centred, the heading "Corrigenda."; below that a three-column table (pag. | lin. | lege.), with the Greek and Latin corrections; at the lower right the closing word "Delen-".

main_text.p: Quæ in aliis, Lector, in hoc quoque Opusculo, typographica subinde menda deprehendes. Inquirere in singula, nec vacat, nec necesse est. Hæc tamen graviora, per Caniculares ferias forte absentibus nobis, irrepsisse animi advertimus.
main_text.head: Corrigenda.

page.notes: The Greek words in the lege column are rough in the scan: ἐκλάμψαν, οὐκ ἂν, ἥδη and the entry for p. 269 (ἡϑ followed by a circular mark) are doubtful and marked [?] or partly illegible. The mark after "Hispaniarum" may be a semicolon or a comma. The closing word "Delen-" is cut off at the edge of the printed flourish and may be incomplete. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
